subject: Operations
title: The Operations Frontier
description: Learn The Operations Frontier in one minute.

hook.text: Can you have the lowest cost and the highest quality at the same time? Most can't. But a few push the frontier.

buildup.text: The operations frontier represents the best achievable performance tradeoff between two competing dimensions.

discovery.text: Companies below the frontier can improve both dimensions. Those on the frontier must trade one for the other.

twist.text: Innovation pushes the frontier outward. Toyota proved you could have low cost and high quality—by changing the game.

climax.text: Companies that push the frontier create sustained competitive advantage that's nearly impossible to copy.

punchline.text: Reach the frontier, then push it further.

quiz.question: What does the operations frontier represent?
options: Best achievable tradeoff between competing dimensions
